It is clear from clause 4 of the will that the testator wanted to give to his grand-daughters an absolute right in the properties that were to devolve on them after the death of his wife, Jageshwar Kuer. The estate bequeathed under clause 4 of the will is not a conditional estate.
For the reasons mentioned above we are in agreement with the courts below that the suit brought by the appellant is unsustainable.

Clause 5 of the will relates to devolution and it does not provide for any divestment of an estate which had vested. The estate that vested on Sheorani was an absolute one. The will does not provide for the divestment of that estate.
For the reasons mentioned above we are in agreement with the courts below that the suit brought by the appellant is unsustainable.
